purpose: Teach: 下る/改める/件名/にせよ/借家/召集/所蔵/年頃

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 犯罪率、本気で、絶対、下る、傾向、続いております、本気で、市民の皆様、感謝、絶対、本当に、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Crime rates have been on a genuine downward trend, and we're grateful for the citizens' support.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Steady cadence, neither rushed nor dragging. Slight emphasis on 'downward trend' — the outcome matters. Professional warmth, not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察対応、本気で、絶対、改めるべきところ、絶対、見直してまいります、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll review our response procedures to the police and make improvements where needed.
lines.style: Earnest agreement. Attentive posture in the voice. Speaking at the officer's pace, not faster. A slight nod in the tone — this is being taken seriously.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察への通報、本気で、件名、絶対、明確に、お伝えください、本気で、迅速対応、絶対、可能になります、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: When reporting to the police, please state the matter clearly so we can respond swiftly.
lines.style: Clear directive, not harsh. Practical tone — this is guidance, not criticism. Slight lean forward on 'clearly.' Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、緊急事態にせよ、本気で、絶対、警察様、ご協力、お願いいたします、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. In any emergency, we'll cooperate fully with your department. We're truly grateful for your support.
lines.style: Sincere commitment. Slightly slower on 'cooperate fully' — showing the weight of the promise. Warm underneath the formality. Genuine gratitude at the close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、借家を、本気で、本拠地、絶対、にしておりました、本気で、捜査、進めております、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝、本気、絶対。
lines.en: The suspect was using a rental property as a base of operations. We're actively investigating.
lines.style: Factual delivery, slightly clinical. Steady pace. Light emphasis on 'base of operations' — establishing the fact. Professional composure, no heat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の召集に、本気で、絶対、応じてまいります、当社、本気で、頑張ります、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll respond to any summons from your department and do everything we can to assist.
lines.style: Firm but not rigid. Straightforward commitment. Slightly careful on 'summons' — showing respect for the process. Underlying warmth without overselling it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠品の所蔵、本気で、警察、絶対、厳重に、しております、本気で、本当に、感謝、しております
lines.en: Evidence has been stored securely under police protocol and is being handled with great care.
lines.style: Assured and careful. Steady, methodical pacing. Light emphasis on 'securely' and 'care' — reassurance through precision. Official but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、結婚適齢期の年頃、本気で、絶対、警察関連、結婚式も、活発化、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We appreciate everything your team has done for us throughout this process.
lines.style: Warm closing. Slightly slower, more personal than previous lines. Genuine appreciation — not perfunctory. A small breath before the close, like settling into sincerity.
